End: OIC 897/1999 approval, PDF page 1, appendix s. 23, printed page 4 (PDF page 5). Corroboration: Auditor General 1999/2000 Report 8, printed pages 53 and 35 (PDF pages 48 and 30).
provincial-rental-housing-corporation.note: Express transfers define both bounds: to Employment and Investment on 18 February 1998 and to Social Development and Economic Security on 21 July 1999. The orders print Provincial Rental Housing Commission; the Auditor General identifies the corporation as PRHC. The end is the next transfer date, not dissolution. Ministerial responsibility is distinct from BC Housing's administration or property ownership.
